title: Polarity-Asymmetric Structural Calibration for Link Sign Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.05896v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Link sign prediction (LSP) aims to infer the positive or negative polarity of unobserved links in signed networks. Signed Graph Neural Networks (SGNNs) usually rely on signed-graph structural priors, including structural balance and homophily-like similarity, to guide message passing and prediction. These priors describe population-level tendencies, not guarantees for individual target edges. Their failures are especially costly under severe sign imbalance, where errors on minority and locally conflicting relations are harder to detect and correct. We propose Polarity-Asymmetric Structural Calibration (PASC), a target-edge structural-prior calibration framework for signed link prediction. PASC constructs a structure-only prior representation, estimates a target-edge structural prior score, and compares this score with a local signed-context cue to derive a conflict residual. translated_title: 链接符号预测的极性非对称结构校准
translated_abstract: 链接符号预测（LSP）旨在推断符号网络中未观测链接的正负极性。符号图神经网络（SGNNs）通常依赖符号图的结构先验，包括结构平衡和类同质性相似性，来指导消息传递和预测。然而，这些先验描述的是群体层面的倾向性，而非对个体目标边的保证。在严重的符号不平衡情况下，这些先验失效的代价尤为高昂，因为少数派和局部冲突关系上的错误更难被检测和纠正。我们提出了极性非对称结构校准（PASC），一个面向符号链接预测的目标边结构先验校准框架。PASC构建仅基于结构的先验表示，估计目标边的结构先验得分，并将该得分与局部符号上下文线索进行比较，从而得出冲突残差。该残差用于校准符号注意力聚合……
tldr: 该论文提出极性非对称结构校准框架PASC，通过目标边结构先验得分与局部符号上下文线索的冲突残差来校准符号注意力聚合，提升了符号网络链接符号预测在严重符号不平衡和局部冲突场景下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PASC, a target-edge structural-prior calibration framework that derives a conflict residual by comparing target-edge structural prior scores with local signed-context cues to calibrate signed attention aggregation, improving link sign prediction robustness under severe sign imbalance and local conflicts.
